name: The Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge
insider_take: This legendary lakeside retreat sits on 700 pristine acres within Jasper National Park, offering the rare privilege of staying inside a UNESCO World Heritage Site surrounded by the Canadian Rockies.
whats_special: The lodge features the world's largest log structure and Canada's #1 resort golf course, designed by Stanley Thompson in 1925. You'll spot elk, deer, and bears wandering the grounds while enjoying direct access to Lac Beauvert's crystal-clear waters.
pro_tip: Book a Millionaire's Row cabin for ultimate privacy and lake views, or time your visit for September when the elk are bugling and aspens turn golden.
dont_miss: The Jasper SkyTram to Whistlers Summit for 360-degree mountain views, canoeing on pristine Maligne Lake, and stargazing in one of the world's largest Dark Sky Preserves. The nearby Columbia Icefield offers glacier walks just 90 minutes away.
pros: Stunning lakefront location on Lac Beauvert with mountain views
Unique cabin-style accommodations in a luxury lodge setting
Access to world-class golf course and outdoor activities
Historic luxury property with authentic Canadian Rockies experience
cons: Remote location requires planning for dining and activities
Seasonal property with limited winter operations
